entities.name: Amjad
entities.description: Swampy northern part of the island of Oneah in the Domains, a region of foul and blighted bogs.

entities.name: King Amjad
entities.description: Cruel tyrant who around 4170 AR ruled the region of Amjad, revered by his servants.

entities.name: Oneah
entities.description: Island in the Domains containing Amjad, Shanodin, Savaea and the Red Mountains.

entities.name: Heart of Shanodin
entities.description: Place where King Amjad brought his servants to know their true nature.

entities.name: Fall of Oneah
entities.description: Event after which King Amjad brought servants to the Heart of Shanodin.

events.summary: After the Fall of Oneah, King Amjad brings his servants into the Heart of Shanodin to learn their real nature.
events.quote: to know the real nature of those whom he chose to keep at his side

relations.note: He ruled the region as tyrant around 4170 AR.
relations.quote: was ruled by the eponymous tyrant, King Amjad

relations.note: Amjad is the northern part of Oneah.
relations.quote: Amjad is the northern part of the island of Oneah in the Domains
